metadata.case_name: MANOHAR CHUGH v. YOGA PLUS LTD

plaintiff.occupation_before: Chairman of Nisha Electronics Industries Limited (employed director)

injuries.description: L5/S1 prolapsed intervertebral disc impinging on the right side S1 nerve root
source: A standby MRI was arranged on 31st May 2007 and showed L5/S1 prolapsed intervertebral disc impinging on the right side S1 nerve root.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of sacral spine

injuries.description: degenerative changes in L4/5 and L5/S1 levels of the spine (pre-existing)
injuries.body_part: lower back / lumbar spine (L4/5 and L5/S1)
source: According to the Discharge Summary dated 31st May 2007, the MRI showed "degenerative changes in L4/5 and L5/S1 levels"
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: right calf muscle tear (minor muscle tear/strain in the proximal peroneus longus and adjacent lateral head of the gastroenemius)
source: According to Dr Ho’s statement, the Plaintiff complained of right calf muscle pain for one day after yoga exercise, and the diagnosis was right calf muscle tear as confirmed by MRI examination.
Such MRI investigation "reported minor muscle tear or strain in the proximal peroneus longus and the adjacent lateral head of the gastroenemius"
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple muscles, fasciae or tendons at lower leg level

injuries.description: chronic low back pain (past medical history)
source: the Plaintiff's past medical history included chronic low back pain, acute appendicitis and cholecystitis.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

manifestations.description: generalised right lower limb weakness (power of about grade 4 out of 5)
limited straight leg raising on right side suggestive of compression on a lumbar nerve root
acute retention of urine (occurred on second day)
"problem with smooth urine flow" (claimed by Plaintiff)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Had to stop playing badminton for 8-9 months after the Accident; upon return wore back support and could only play doubles and not singles.

Missed an important meeting with the Chief Executive on 1st June 2007 and unable to attend the "Cool Biz" Fashion Show on 3rd June 2007 as guest performer, causing disappointment and loss of opportunity to advocate a cause and participate in a community/business event.
